verdict: PARTIAL. CFG closed unconditionally (ratio <= 1/2, no side hypotheses); a precise obstruction identified for the rest; no refutation found.

CFG_unconditional.statement: CFG => ratio <= 1/2 with no extra hypotheses. j-poor branch from thm:cfg (mu>=T/8); j-rich branch from a new finite check giving mu>=T/6.

j_rich_check.why_load_bearing: ratio = 3/2-6mu for mu<=1/6 in the j-rich branch, so mu=1/8 would give ratio 3/4 and REFUTE s(5)=1/2
j_rich_check.control: dropping the pinning restores feasibility, 3/31 anchors

CFG_unconditional.consequence: Corollary 23's first extra hypothesis (starved player Lmin-poor) is unnecessary FOR THE BOUND; it and the second survive only in the sharper statement pinning the ratio at exactly 1/2.

arithmetic_ceiling.statement: From A3 plus core membership of both vectors alone, the sharpest possible ratio bound is exactly 3/2 (n=5); 4/3 (n=4), 8/5 (n=6).
arithmetic_ceiling.meaning: A3-style reasoning can never reach 1/2; every configuration needs its own LOWER bound on the leximin floor mu, which is what thm:cfg supplies for CFG.
arithmetic_ceiling.anchor_tightness: nu=M attained at S0 forces Lmax constant = M on S0; lambda=mu attained at S1 forces Lmin constant = mu on S1

localization_lemma.statement: mu >= min_i Lmax_i (one line: f(S) >= Lmax(S) since Lmax is a core point, then A3).
localization_lemma.consequence: only configurations whose Lmax has a ZERO coordinate are hard; the rest close by gap arithmetic.

new_results.lemma0: no slack strict boundary => exact partition at Lmin => Lorenz-greatest => Lmin=Lmax => ratio 0 (write-up in REPORT.txt section 1)
